description: Email service definitions with host and verification metadata

hosts.description: List of domain hostnames for this service

old_hosts.description: List of outdated/discontinued domain hostnames for this service

type.description: Service type classification: free/paid providers, forwarding/alias services (always strict-tier for consumers), reserved = special-use names

oneOf.description: Verification method required during signup. 'none' and 'email' still allow anonymous use (strict-tier for consumers); mobile/phone/sms/payment/other verify identity (whitelist-tier). Unset = unknown, treated as verified.
Verification methods required during signup; anonymous use possible if 'none' or 'email' is present

mx_hosts.description: List of MX (mail exchange) hostnames for the service

discontinued.description: Whether the email service has been discontinued
